essence: That person gains the ability to speak fluently in both prose and verse in an assembly.
Even dull people become eloquent through familiarity with his speech.
The practitioner certainly obtains the fruit equivalent to performing a hundred-thousand-seat ritual.
The intended practice is to mutter the mantra one thousand and eight times every day.
In that context, the prescribed counting is one thousand and eight.
